update.releaseNotes:
v5.10.15 - Unity Cup Extreme Spirit Burst support
Added ----- - Unity Cup: training analysis now detects the Extreme Spirit Burst added in the July 2026 rework (the purple burst that appears on a facility after its regular Spirit Burst) and prioritizes it above a regular burst, since it guarantees 0% failure chance plus bonus stats/stat-cap increases and an Ignited Spirit skill hint.
